title: Introduction Worship Strengthens Belief And Orders Life

questions.question: What helps belief become strong inside a Muslim?
questions.answer: Worship does.

questions.question: What can happen if belief is not helped by worship?
questions.answer: It can stay weak and not do much.

questions.question: What two kinds of things are included in worship here?
questions.answer: Doing what Allah tells us and staying away from what He forbids.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship can bring in this life and the next life?
questions.answer: Happiness in both.

questions.question: Besides happiness, what else can worship help put in good shape?
questions.answer: A person’s life here and in the Hereafter.

questions.question: Worship is a special relationship between whom?
questions.answer: Between the Creator and His servant.

questions.question: Why is worship important for a person’s character?
questions.answer: It helps belief become part of who the person is.

questions.question: Is worship only for one person alone, or can it help groups too?
questions.answer: It can help both people and groups.

questions.question: What is one main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: Worship helps belief grow strong and brings good in this world and the next.

questions.question: What makes belief settle deeply in a believer?
questions.answer: Worship does.

questions.question: What are we doing in worship according to the passage?
questions.answer: We obey Allah’s commands and avoid His forbidden things.

questions.question: What part of a person can stay weak if it is not supported by worship?
questions.answer: The part that knows and feels the truth inside.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the condition of the Muslim world?
questions.answer: It shows what happens when belief is weak.

questions.question: What kind of happiness comes from worship?
questions.answer: Happiness now and later in the Hereafter.

questions.question: How does worship help life besides giving happiness?
questions.answer: It helps organize life.

questions.question: Does the passage say worship helps only one person, or also the community?
questions.answer: It helps both the person and the community.

questions.question: What kind of bond is worship called?
questions.answer: A noble bond between Allah and His servant.

questions.question: What should a Muslim child learn from this passage?
questions.answer: Worship is very important because it strengthens faith and brings goodness.

questions.question: According to the passage, what puts belief into a person’s character?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: What does worship include doing?
questions.answer: Following Allah’s orders.

questions.question: What else does worship include not doing?
questions.answer: Things Allah said not to do.

questions.question: What does the passage use as proof that weak belief is a real problem?
questions.answer: The condition of Muslims today.

questions.question: In which two places does worship bring happiness?
questions.answer: In this world and in the next world.

questions.question: Is worship described as low and ordinary or high and honored?
questions.answer: High and honored.

questions.question: Who are connected by worship?
questions.answer: The Creator and the servant.

questions.question: If a person wants faith to be strong, what should that person do?
questions.answer: Worship Allah and keep away from what He forbids.

questions.question: What makes the truths of faith become firm in believers?
questions.answer: Worship makes them firm.

questions.question: If inner belief is not fed and strengthened, how may it become?
questions.answer: Weak and not effective.

questions.question: What feeds and strengthens belief in this passage?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: What does worship ask from a Muslim?
questions.answer: To do Allah’s commands and leave His forbidden things.

questions.question: What does the passage say the present Muslim world shows us?
questions.answer: That weak worship leads to weak faith.

questions.question: What does worship cause in this life?
questions.answer: Happiness and a well-ordered life.

questions.question: What does worship cause in the next life?
questions.answer: Happiness there too.

questions.question: Can worship help only private life, or public life too?
questions.answer: It can help both.

questions.question: How is the relationship in worship described?
questions.answer: It is noble and honored.

questions.question: What is a good short summary of the passage?
questions.answer: Worship strengthens faith and brings goodness for people and society.

questions.question: What is one big job of worship in a believer’s life?
questions.answer: It makes faith a real part of the person.

questions.question: What happens to ideas of faith if worship does not support them?
questions.answer: They stay weak.

questions.question: Which actions are named as part of worship?
questions.answer: Obeying Allah and avoiding what He forbids.

questions.question: Why is worship not just something extra?
questions.answer: Because it gives strength to belief.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship is a cause of?
questions.answer: Happiness in both worlds.

questions.question: How does worship help life?
questions.answer: It brings order to life here and in the Hereafter.

questions.question: What kinds of growth can come through worship?
questions.answer: Personal growth and growth for the whole group.

questions.question: Between which two is worship a special connection?
questions.answer: Between Allah and His servant.

questions.question: If a classmate says worship only matters later, how would this passage answer?
questions.answer: It matters now and later.

questions.question: What helps the beliefs of Islam become part of someone’s character?
questions.answer: Worship.

questions.question: What can happen to thoughts and feelings about faith without worship?
questions.answer: They can remain weak.

questions.question: What are the two sides of worship mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Doing what Allah commands and not doing what He forbids.

questions.question: What example from real life is mentioned to show this is true?
questions.answer: The state of the Muslim world today.

questions.question: What does worship lead to in this world?
questions.answer: Happiness and better order in life.

questions.question: What does worship lead to in the next world?
questions.answer: Happiness there too.

questions.question: Does worship help only one person’s success, or also everyone together?
questions.answer: It helps both the person and everyone together.

questions.question: What kind of link is worship between Allah and a person?
questions.answer: A high and honored link.

questions.question: What is the best main lesson from this passage?
questions.answer: Worship is necessary because it strengthens faith and brings success in both worlds.
